title: Hospitality rent_roll class contract
description: Format §4.3 Hospitality Variant / RFC 0081 G3. Applies to the rent_roll payload of a document whose asset_class is hospitality. available_room_nights is required when rent_roll is stated (CLS-04 otherwise); occupied_room_nights, adr and occupancy are optional. The key count is stated only as property.keys, so rent_roll.keys is refused. Other rent_roll members are not constrained by this fragment.

available_room_nights.description: Keys × days in the period. The RevPAR denominator.

occupied_room_nights.description: Room nights sold in the period.

not.description: The key count lives only in property.keys (RFC 0081 G3).
